info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Ozmosi API
Returns the daily files of Clinical Trial Details from Open:FactSet Partner - Ozmosi.

params.name: _sort
params.description: Enables to get the data in ascending or descending order based on startTime. Results are in reverse chronological order if this parameter is not used.

params.name: _paginationLimit
params.description: Specifies the maximum number of results to return per result Default value 20 and Maximum value 300

params.name: _paginationOffset
params.description: Specifies the starting point for pagination. This parameter is used to identify the beginning of next set of results. Using this parameter can fetch maximum of first 10000 records.

params.name: clinicalTrialId
params.description: This parameter specifies Ozmosi unique ID for each historical version of a trial.

params.name: officialTitle
params.value: A Phase 1/2 Study of the Highly-selective RET Inhibitor, BLU-667, in Patients With Thyroid Cancer, Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) and Other Advanced Solid Tumors
params.description: Specifies full scientific title of a trial.

params.name: trialId
params.description: This parameter specifies ID of the trial assigned by the trial registry.

params.name: date
params.description: Specifies the timestamp of each version of a trial in YYYY-MM-DD format.

items.docs: Returns the daily files of Clinical Trial Details from Open:FactSet Partner - Ozmosi.
